children: Overview
Belgium-based healthcare REIT's H1 rental income rose 62% yr/yr on Cofinimmo acquisition
EPRA Earnings for H1 climbed 54% yr/yr, driven by merger accretion
Company completed Cofinimmo merger and appointed new board and executive committee
Outlook
Aedifica estimates 2026 EPRA Earnings at €436 mln, or €5.35/share
Company proposes a 2026 dividend of €4.20/share, up 5%
Aedifica expects full run-rate merger synergies of at least €16 mln in 2027
Result Drivers
COFINIMMO MERGER - Company said acquisition and merger with Cofinimmo drove substantial increases in rental income and EPRA Earnings
LIKE-FOR-LIKE GROWTH - Rental income rose 1.7% on a like-for-like basis in H1, indicating underlying portfolio growth
NEW INVESTMENTS - €84 mln of new investments in H1, with €111 mln announced over summer, contributed to portfolio expansion
